g.text: A synchronous generator’s power-angle curve follows its phase circuit

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Balanced wye generator, phase RMS magnitudes E_a=260 V,V_an=240 V,X_s=10 Ω. Current leaves the generator; δ=angle(E_a)−angle(V_an). The sine curve
neglects R_a and assumes fixed excitation/terminal voltage; its 90° maximum is an ideal static limit, not a complete stability guarantee.
